pages.text: Press $(k:jojoha.summon_stand) to call your Stand out or send it back. Hold it to change stance.$(br2)$(k:jojoha.skill_modifier) with $(k:jojoha.summon_stand) switches between the whole Stand and just its arms.

Its moves sit on $(k:jojoha.stand_skill_1) to $(k:jojoha.stand_skill_4), and the same keys with $(k:jojoha.skill_modifier).$(br2)Moves cost Stand energy. $(warn)Run it dry and your Stand fades$() until it gathers itself again.$(br2)Only Stands can hurt Stands, and $(warn)what a Stand takes, its user feels$().
